digest.component_or_area: ticket store write and read-back path
propositions: A description write verified at 14,997 chars was silently replaced by a stale 10,582-char revision without error, while a plan-review was running on the same ticket.
Optimistic concurrency did not fire: the losing write reported success and passed read-back verification, then was rolled back later rather than raising ConcurrencyError on conflict.
Concurrent edit + in-flight REVIEW_RESULT sidecar events on the same ticket trigger store reconvergence that allows a stale whole-description EDIT to overwrite a newer verified write.

A reducer-cache race (commit 0b964c82f5) can explain successful immediate read-back followed by stale data on later read, and a stale-base whole-field last-writer-wins overwrite is reproducible on current main.
